privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Profik Pro collects and how it is used. Profik Pro is the PRO-side app of the Profik marketplace, which connects clients with PRO in the Czech Republic.
privacy.dataCollected: Account details you provide (name, email, phone number, password), the responses and messages you send to clients, and your balance top-up history.
privacy.location: While you are using the app, we use your device location to show open jobs near you on the map and how far each job is from your current position. Location is not tracked in the background.
privacy.notifications: We use your device's push notification token to alert you about new client messages and response updates.
privacy.balance: Topping up your balance is completed in an external, secure Stripe checkout page opened in your browser - Profik Pro does not store your card details.
privacy.sharing: Clients can see your name, profile, and the responses you send on their jobs. Your phone number is never shared with clients - all communication happens through the in-app chat.
privacy.retention: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active. You can permanently delete your account at any time from Account settings -> Delete account; your past responses and messages are anonymized rather than removed, so job history for clients stays intact.
privacy.contact: If you have questions about this policy, contact us at {{email}}.
privacy.fullVersion: Read the full Privacy Policy at profik.app

support.title: Help & Support
support.intro: Need a hand with something? Here are answers to common questions, or you can reach us directly.
support.faq1A: On the Open Jobs tab, browse jobs near you on the map and list. Tap a job to see its service type, property details, location, and the client's budget.
support.faq2Q: How do I send a response?
support.faq2A: Open a job, tap Send Response, set your price and an optional message, then submit. Track it in My Jobs under Sent / Accepted / Declined.
support.faq3Q: How do I message a client?
support.faq3A: Open your response and tap into the chat to message the client directly - no need to share your phone number.
support.faq4Q: How do I top up my balance?
support.faq4A: Open Balance from your profile, enter an amount, and continue to the secure payment page. Your balance is used to pay platform fees.
support.faq5Q: How do I delete my account?
support.faq5A: Go to Account settings and scroll to Delete account. This permanently removes your account and cannot be undone.
support.contactFallback: Couldn't open your email app. Please email us at {{email}} instead.

verification.title: Identity verification
verification.intro: Confirm who you are with a government ID. Clients see a verified badge on your profile and on every response you send.
verification.stepDocument: Photograph your ID card, passport or residence permit.

verification.whatWeKeepBody: Your photos go straight to our verification partner and never reach Profik. We keep only the result, your first name, the first letter of your surname, and the type and expiry of the document.
